question:
**Identify the correct spelling of the underlined word.**

Alcohol causes __intocsication.__
solution:
The correct answer is: **Intoxication**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct spelling of the underlined word is "**intoxication**."
 
• The word is spelled with an "**x**" and not a "**k**" or a "**c**."
 
• The word is a noun that refers to the state of being drunk or under the influence of alcohol or drugs. (नशे में होने या शराब या नशीली दवाओं के प्रभाव में होने की अवस्था)
 
 
• **Example**: *His slurred speech and unsteady gait indicated a state of intoxication.*
 
 
 
• The word can also refer to the process of administering toxins or poisonous substances to a person or animal.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.
